_comment: The port lands in the existing scratchy crate, not a new one:
It is called from emit_run in crates/targets/spyre/src/lower_subtile_tape_to_dataflow_ir.rs —
the only place the typed dataflow_ir::Run exists. There is no MLIR text on the input side and
no parser in this crate: the input is a typed value and the output is typed sentient ops.
No -sys crate: this is a complete port with no C interop boundary.

deeptools._comment_target_module: All ported code goes under src/bridges/dataflow_ir_to_sentient/.

agen_to_sentient._comment: The transfer statements: load_and_send, receive_and_store, load_and_store, addressing, ldtype, bursts, interleave.

dataflow_to_sentient._comment: Unit and group lowering, the sync statements, the corelet-N neighbour naming.

vectorchain._comment: The computes: mac, binary, unary, splat, merge/pack, the gcvt/fcvt table, masks, PT and PE/SFP lowering.

transform._comment: The in-place DataflowIR rewrites: program-unit reduction, mutable start-addr shifting, paged memory views, flattening, toggle canonicalisation.

standard_and_scf._comment: arith/scf/affine to sentient: scalar ops, constants, branches, terminators.
